memories.content: Specify the order and recipients for reporting serious discomfort during the study.
Field staff rely on a pre-defined contact sequence when serious discomfort is reported.
Establish criteria for halting the use of a design alternative if recurring severe errors appear during formative evaluation.
Do not include a design alternative halted for safety reasons in subsequent evaluation iterations without modification.
Even in controlled environments, delayed prototype recovery procedures increase session interruption time and alter data collection conditions for the same task.
HCI reviewers find it difficult to assess result reproducibility if the system version used in the field deployment is not disclosed.
Record changes in system configurations, field procedures, and data collection tools during deployment, along with their timestamps and rationales.
The history of deployment versions and configuration changes provides necessary evidence for interpreting results from different field sites.

analysis.overview: The frames address separate operational areas. The reference covers discomfort escalation, safety-based evaluation controls, and prototype-recovery effects, while the compared frame focuses on deployment provenance needed to interpret and reproduce field results. No scope-aligned overlap or contradiction is established.

relations.reason: The reference memories state complementary parts of one escalation-protocol claim: the sequence must be specified, and field staff rely on it. The compared frame contains no corresponding claim.
relations.summary: Serious discomfort is handled through a specified reporting sequence with defined recipients.

relations.summary: Delayed prototype recovery can lengthen interruptions and alter data-collection conditions even in controlled settings.

relations.reason: The compared memories split one provenance claim across version disclosure, timestamped change records with rationales, and the evidentiary value of deployment history. The reference frame contains no corresponding provenance policy.
relations.summary: Deployment versions and operational changes should be disclosed and documented to support interpretation and reproducibility of field results.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame emphasizes disclosing deployment versions and documenting configuration, procedure, and tool changes so field results remain interpretable and reproducible.
reports.reference_only: The reference specifies serious-discomfort escalation, criteria and follow-up restrictions for unsafe design alternatives, and the methodological effects of delayed prototype recovery.
